page.layout: One column of running text at full width. In the middle, after paragraph 5, a tree diagram (dichotomy) with a rotated label at its left edge. Running head and page number at the top. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: 4. In omni loco invenitur aliqua loci differētia, nempe sursum aut deorsum: & naturaliter unumquodque corpus, quādo est extra proprium locum, omnibus viribus ad ipsum fertur, cumq; eo pervenerit, conquiescit.
main_text.l: Per accidēs. horum tamen quaedam mouentur
Etiam per se: sicut partes alicuius corporis, quæ mouentur quidem cum toto corpore per accidens, interea tamen etiā per se moueri possunt.
Nullo modo per se, sed tantum per accidens: sicut albedo & scientia, quæ nunquam sanè mutant locum, nisi cum eo cui insunt.
main_text.p: 6. Locus non est totum continens aliquam rem, sed tantum extremum cōtinentis. Quod probatur: nā solius extremi eius gratia aliquid dicitur esse in loco. veluti in cœlo esse diceris, quia in aere: & in aere,

page.notes: The rotated label at the left of the diagram was read from the scan and written as its own line. Long s is written as plain s throughout (for example "sursum", "deorsum", "est"). u/v and i/j are normalised (inuenitur, uiribus, peruenerit, veluti). Printed macrons (differētia, accidēs, etiā, nā, cōtinentis, sanè) and æ/œ are kept as printed. "Quod" is printed with a mark under the Q, which is not reproduced. The paragraph beginning "Locus" runs on past the foot of the page, so it is not marked cont.
